products.title: The Double Pleated Short • Chocolate Brown
products.body_html:
A warm-weather take on a timeless silhouette. The Double Pleated Cotton Short is crafted from 100% cotton with a structured yet breathable feel designed to get better with wear.

Featuring double front pleats and a relaxed fit through the leg, these shorts take inspiration from the classic golf silhouettes of the ’80s and ’90s while being refined for today.

Designed to be worn on or off the course.

products.title: Nylon Vest • Tan
products.body_html:
Designed with a clean, structured silhouette, this vest is filled with premium duck down for dependable insulation without the bulk. The outer shell is crafted from 100% recycled polyester, offering durability with a smooth, matte finish.

Finished with a stand collar, two-way front zip, and angled zip pockets, it layers effortlessly over knits or tees on the course or off. Subtle crest detailing at the chest and minimal branding at the back keep it understated.

Details

  • Structured, relaxed fit
  • Stand collar
  • Two-way front zip closure
  • Angled zip pockets
  • Subtle crest branding at chest
  • Minimal TPU gel back neck label

products.title: Mock Neck • Black
products.body_html:
Crafted from a premium 280 GSM Sorona double yarn jersey, this tee has a substantial feel while staying soft and breathable. The cotton-sorona blend adds natural structure with subtle stretch, designed to hold its shape over time.

Finished with a relaxed, modern fit and a clean mock neckline, it’s made to be worn effortlessly on or off the course. Signature crest detailing at the hem and minimal branding at the back.

Details

  • Soft structure with natural stretch
  • Relaxed, slightly oversized fit
  • Mock neck collar
  • Signature Woodgrain crest label at hem
  • Minimal TPU gel neck branding on back

products.title: Cable Knit Sweater Vest • Black
products.body_html: A 100% jersey cotton cable knit sweater with a classic crew neckline and relaxed fit. Knit with medium-weight yarns for year-round comfort and texture. Finished with our WG chest embroidery and ribbed cuffs/hem for a timeless look inspired by vintage sportswear.

products.title: Wool Hat
products.body_html:
Description

A wool 5 panel hat in a brown plaid pattern, finished with our WG 3D logo embroidery. Designed with subtle light woodgrain stitching on the side and a dark green interior. Structured with a semi-curved brim and adjustable leather strap and metal buckle closure.
